'''Xavier Gateway''' was the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of [[Soaring Star Specialized]]. [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] alerted Gateway to the danger posed by a planned [[Miner/Legends|miners']] strike.<ref name="Game" />
